features.quote: Resignation: Model outputs a terminal phrase ("I cannot solve this," "I am giving up").
Success Hallucination: Model outputs "Task Completed" despite error logs (counted as a unique failure mode).
Implement a "sliding window" or summarizer for the error logs so the model always sees the *most recent* error, ensuring we test "rattle" (frustration) rather than "confusion" (context overflow).
features.justification_quote: ensuring we test "rattle" (frustration) rather than "confusion" (context overflow)
